items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday’s game. Sam Darnold is off the injury report and good to go for Seahawks.
items.why: Official ruling from team/Schefter; elbow dislocation.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; impacts WAS pass-catchers in tough matchup vs SEA.
items.opportunity: Elevated opportunity for Mariota-connected WRs/TEs if any role expansion.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe). Coach: Jaylen Warren will lead the group and stay fresh. Levitan: Vertical pass game failing for Rodgers; expect zillion checkdowns to Warren. Backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.why: Toe injury; official out. Warren Q (shoulder) but projected lead.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back with receiving upside vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Warren lead carries + checkdowns; high snap/route share expected.

items.text: Texans have ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday’s game at Indianapolis due to his hamstring injury. Did not practice all week.
items.why: Hamstring; no practice Wed-Fri; insider expectations of multi-week absence.
items.implication: Continued heavy TE usage; thin HOU WR corps.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz high target share (30% routes/28% share last week sans Collins); Colts allow TE yards.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) will not practice and is doubtful vs Broncos. McVay: barring setback, expected back Week 4 vs Eagles. No IR lean.
items.why: Hip/groin; no practice; McVay cautious, pre-hernia feel but not hernia.
items.implication: Likely miss second straight; Adams continues as WR1.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams high target/production share; TE involvement up.

items.text: Patriots IR list includes WR A.J. Brown (among 16 already, matching full 2025 total). Unnatural prior injury luck noted as key to past overperformance.
items.why: Placed on IR; multi-week expected from prior sprain reports.
items.implication: Longer absence for NE; depth chart hit.
items.opportunity: Other NE WRs elevated while Brown out.

items.text: Broncos ruled out RB Jonah Coleman (ankle). RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams.
items.why: Official Friday report; Coleman out, others cleared.
items.implication: Committee with healthy Dobbins/Harvey; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Dobbins/Harvey primary touches; Coleman absence locks roles.

items.text: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (glute) off the injury report and good to go at Washington.
items.implication: Full SEA offense available vs WAS (Daniels out).
items.opportunity: Stabilizes SEA pass game for WRs.

items.text: Packers WR routes without Jayden Reed (neck/back): Watson 45, Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.why: First game sans Reed; high route shares for Watson/Golden.
items.implication: Elevated opportunity for Watson/Golden while Reed out.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets (8% share) through 3 games. TPRR last 2 yrs: 33% with London off, 17% with London on.
items.why: Low route participation and target share; heavily suppressed when London plays.
items.implication: Pitts fade continues as London-dominant ATL offense.
items.opportunity: London commands targets; Pitts limited independent value.

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% of routes and 28% team target share. Faces Colts allowing 4th-most TE yards.
items.why: Collins absence drove elite TE usage; matchup favorable.
items.implication: Schultz TE1 play while Collins sidelined (out again W3).
items.opportunity: High target rate on routes; volume vacuum in HOU.

items.text: Bills listing WR D.J. Moore as questionable for Sunday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Monitor; potential impact on BUF WR depth/targets.
items.opportunity: If out, more for other BUF pass-catchers.

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead W3.
items.why: Clear snap/touch lead after Stevenson mistake; pass-pro still limits full takeover.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full lead; monitor committee.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead short-term.

items.text: Drake London in 12 career games with Michael Penix: >20 PPR PPG, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game.
items.why: Elite historical production/target share with Penix.
items.implication: Strong WR1 floor/ceiling with Penix under center.

items.text: Berry Love: Brock Purdy (vs ARI, high total/bad secondary), Derrick Henry (vs DAL weak run D), Chris Olave (vs LV high YPR allowed, double-digit tgts/air yards).
items.implication: Start with confidence in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: Purdy volume vs weak ARI; Henry rush volume; Olave target monopoly.
